summary.text: ip-01 flooded host-01 with requests twice, at 13:24 and 13:30, while user-01 was logged on.

claim.text: Two request floods against one host from one address fit a denial of service attempt.

sequence.text: ip-01 flooded host-01 with requests while user-01 was logged on.
Six minutes later a second flood hit host-01.

findings.text: Two request floods from ip-01 hit host-01 six minutes apart.
The earlier logon of user-01 to host-02 is a context event and is not shown to be part of the attack.

impact.text: The service on host-01 may have been slowed or unavailable during the floods.

recommendations.action: Check whether the service on host-01 stayed available during both floods.
Consider rate limiting requests from ip-01.
recommendations.reversible_alternative: Alert on request rates from ip-01 before limiting them.

risk_justification.text: The given medium score fits two floods against one host with no sign of compromise.

uncertainties.statement: The events do not show whether the service on host-01 went down.
uncertainties.missing_evidence: Availability monitoring or response-time logs for host-01.

limitations: Only two flagged events and one context event were given.
